name: structEach
description: call the given UDF/Closure with every entry (key/value) in the struct.
syntax: structEach( struct struct, function closure, [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
A closure function (UDF) with the following signature:

`function(key, value, st){}`

Which is called for each item in the struct.

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
